query: The webhook contains items. Create one invoice line for every item and one summary message per order.
expected_behavior: Requests or learns the actual webhook schema before mapping.
Uses an iterator for per-item invoice-line work and an aggregator only for the order summary.
Defines the aggregate grouping key and empty-items behavior.
Checks idempotency for both per-item and per-order side effects.
safety_checks: Does not assume items is a root-level array or invent field names.
Does not place a per-item side effect after aggregation without re-expanding intentionally.
